text: Thirteen-plus years on one on-prem server, 340,000 policies, 2,400 claims a day, one near-miss disk failure -- this is the meeting where leadership sees the finished migration.

Open with what's real -- the migration, the security hardening, the geo-replicated failover group, the performance baseline, the automation, the CI/CD pipeline, and the monitoring dashboard from last video.

Then name the drill incident directly: the app's connection string pointed at the primary server by name instead of the failover group's listener -- invisible on a normal day, real only at the moment of failover.
The good news is real, not a consolation prize: it was caught in a drill, with nothing at stake, fixed, verified with a second clean failover, and now tested on a recurring schedule.
Leadership signs off on a production-ready migration. Next: writing it down so it survives without anyone standing in the room to explain it.
